bound.rule: analysis fails if panel-unparsed rows exceed 1%

panel_unparsed.handling: excluded from all rates, paired contrasts, breakdowns, and judge agreement; paired contrasts drop a pair when either side is unparsed; scenario-majority is restricted to scenarios with all five seeds parsed

interpretation_rule: adapted cross-model comparisons are descriptive pipeline comparisons, not causal generator effects
